title: EXAMPLE — copy this whole block for each new recipe, then delete this one
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper, then sear in a hot pan with oil until golden, about 6 minutes per side.
Steam or roast the broccoli until tender-crisp, about 5 minutes.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Slice the chicken, drizzle everything with soy sauce, and top with sesame seeds.
